entities.name: Bicyclic secondary amine
observations: Tokenized structure decodes as ethyl azabicyclic carboxylate, CCOC(=O)C1C2CNCC21.
The nitrogen is secondary and is functionalized in the product.

entities.name: Cyclobutanone
observations: Tokenized structure decodes as cyclobutanone, O=C1CCC1.
Its carbonyl carbon becomes bonded to the bicyclic amine nitrogen in the product.

entities.name: Reductive amination with cyclobutanone
observations: Secondary bicyclic amine plus cyclobutanone gives an N-cyclobutyl tertiary amine.
The transformation proceeds through an imine or iminium intermediate followed by reduction; exact database conditions were not retrieved.

entities.name: Sodium triacetoxyborohydride conditions
observations: Plausible reagent set: cyclobutanone, sodium triacetoxyborohydride, dichloromethane, optionally with a small amount of acetic acid, at room temperature.

entities.name: Sodium cyanoborohydride conditions
observations: Alternative plausible reagent set: sodium cyanoborohydride in methanol or dichloroethane under mildly acidic conditions.

entities.name: Catalytic hydrogenation conditions
observations: Catalytic hydrogenation of the imine or iminium intermediate is a possible alternative, but less specifically supported than borohydride reductive amination.
